name: Boca Grande
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Boca Grande?
answer_short: Partly. In Boca Grande, electric golf carts may use the island bike path at up to 15 mph. Plain golf carts aren't designated for the island's roads; street-legal LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less.

rules.rule: Electric golf carts may use the Boca Grande bike path, 15 mph max, 50 inches wide max
Plain golf carts only on roads a city or county has designated and signed for carts
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; cross faster roads only at intersections
County ordinance on the Boca Grande path

banned_roads.name: Gas golf carts on the bike path

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Boca Grande?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a gas golf cart on the Boca Grande bike path?
faq.a: No. Only electric carts may use the path.
